build_visual_genome_dataset: build the Visual Genome dataset by downloading and extracting imdb and features for training
create_visual_genome_builder: create a VisualGenomeBuilder instance that extends VQA2Builder with dataset name and class configuration
download_and_extract_imdb: download and extract the Visual Genome imdb tar file and move the synset vocab file
download_and_extract_features: download and extract the Visual Genome features archive to the specified data folder
get_config_path: get the default YAML config path for the Visual Genome dataset builder
